file.description: Repo-relative path of the published measurement file.

sha256.description: Digest of the file's CRLF-normalized text, the same normalization scripts/lib/runner.mjs applies to every check's input -- not a pin of the exact bytes a client fetches from url.

url.description: The raw.githubusercontent.com URL a practice or antipattern cites as its source.

anchor.description: Optional: the sources/registry.json anchor id (role: published-static) that watches this file for a post-publication change.
